paragraphs: The X-Type 2.0d uses the ZSD-420 — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel engine sourced from Ford. It was fitted from 2003 to 2009 across the X400 generation, representing the diesel entry point to the X-Type range. The ZSD-420 is a belt-driven unit, making the timing belt an interval-service item rather than a failure pattern, but injectors can show wear at higher mileages. The X-Type 2.0d is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. Jaguar X-Type 2.0d Engine Compatibility The X-Type 2.0d uses a single engine code, the ZSD-420, across its entire production run. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm: - Your exact engine code (ZSD-420) via registration or VIN - Your generation (X400) - Ancillary and drivetrain specification This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic X-Type quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the X-Type 2.0d from 2023 to present. The engine features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older engine V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every engine rebuild.
